purpose: Rolling Rifle semantic, structural-selector, and recommendation-comparison authority. Rifle role diversity is represented without introducing weapon-only semantic vocabulary.

vocabularyPolicy.semanticRule: Every semantic tag must already be used by a certified feat or talent in the frozen 183-tag union.

selectorPolicy.purpose: Represent exact weapon, weapon-family, group, and proficiency applicability separately from semantic tags.
selectorPolicy.genericRifleAbilityRule: Generic rifle abilities should match weapon-group:rifle or weapon-proficiency:rifles.
selectorPolicy.namedWeaponRule: Named ability cases such as Riflemaster and Sport Hunter must use exact/family applicability proven by the published ability. Broad family membership must not silently grant an exact named benefit.
selectorPolicy.weaponDeclarationPrinciple: Weapons declare what they are; abilities declare what they apply to.

comparisonPolicy.variantSelectionRule: Prefer a specialized rifle when its range, fire-mode, accuracy/setup, damage, control, or utility profile matches the character's build better than the standard Blaster Rifle and its tradeoffs do not conflict with that build.
